theme: Dark Theme (Archetype 7: Electric & Neon - Creator Edition)

headings.rules: Use for H1-H4. MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter). Never center-align by default.

body.rules: Use for all paragraphs, labels, and small text. Keep leading-relaxed for body text.

typography.hierarchy_rules: H1 max size is text-5xl to text-6xl. Do NOT use text-8xl. Overlines must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]). Gap between heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.

colors.rules: Dark mode default. Never use pure black #000000, use tinted dark gray/blue (zinc-950). Use Neon Yellow (hsl(70 100% 50%)) for primary CTAs like 'Criar meu roteiro' to pop. Use the accent gradient for AI-generated text highlights or borders.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky headers/floating navs: bg-zinc-950/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10. Must have 1px inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use drop-shadows with primary/accent colors for active states (e.g., drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,255,0,0.4)]).
visual_enhancers.background_texture: Subtle noise or grain overlay to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or aggressive sharp corners. Must have strong hover state (translate-y-[-2px] + intense shadow).

grids.marketing: MODE A: TETRIS GRID. Asymmetrical bento grid for features. Use col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2 for hero feature, col-span-4 for supporting. Huge gaps (gap-8 to gap-12).
grids.dashboard: MODE B: HIGH DENSITY. Dashboard uses grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. gap-6. Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle border, no shadow.

components.form_generator: Do not use standard generic forms. Group inputs (Tema, Plataforma, Duração, etc.) in a sleek bento-style card. Use Shadcn Select/Input but style them with bg-zinc-900 border-white/10 focus:border-primary.
components.ai_result: Render the script result (Hook, Cenas, Narração, etc.) in a glowing/gradient-bordered container to emphasize 'AI Magic'.
components.pricing_cards: Use 'Tracing Beam' or glowing border for the R$5/mês Premium plan. Dark UI with stark neon yellow CTA.
components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for an 'Editorial Ribbon' of platforms (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) or creator benefits. Slow drift, massive outline text in the background.
components.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight) for a high-end app feel. Command: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-8, p-12 for containers. py-24, py-32 for marketing sections.
layouts.hero: Max overlay opacity bg-black/40. Left-aligned content. Big bold Unbounded H1. Primary CTA 'Criar meu roteiro'.

motion.hover: Hover states must be a lighter hue or have a glow. Always explicitly set hover text color.
motion.transitions: Specific transitions: transition-transform duration-300 ease-out, transition-colors duration-200. NEVER use transition-all.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for dashboard grid items and marketing features.

media.3d_libraries: Framer Motion for entrance and hover animations. No heavy 3D required, keep it fast. Alternatively use Phosphor icons with motion.

hero_background.description: Gaming workspace with computer and neon signs in purple light (use as dark hero background with overlay)

feature_abstract_1.description: Floating metallic cubes (use for AI generation visual/feature card)

feature_abstract_2.description: Bright red and blue circle (use for analytics/dashboard preview visual)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Text over images must have text-shadow.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must be highly visible (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).

general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='generate-script-button').
general_ui_ux_guidelines.toast: Use sonner for notifications (e.g., 'Roteiro salvo!', 'Link copiado').
general_ui_ux_guidelines.transparent_backgrounds: CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, dropdowns, or any surface that has content under it.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.alignment: Paragraphs and forms MUST be left-aligned for readability. Do not center-align the app container.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application completely in pt-BR (Brazilian Portuguese).
Use dark mode as the default and primary theme. Force dark mode if necessary by adding the 'dark' class to html.
Integrate Shadcn UI components but heavily customize their background, borders, and hover states to match the electric/neon dark theme described above.
Implement the Landing page with the Hero, Como funciona, Benefícios, Exemplos, Preços, FAQ.
Implement the Dashboard with 'Meus roteiros' (history) and usage stats (Free 5/mês vs Premium 100/mês).
Implement the Script Generator form with fields: Tema, Plataforma, Duração, Nicho, Estilo, Tom. Use a sleek, tech-forward UI.
Display the generated script cleanly with sections for: Hook, Roteiro, Cenas, Narração, Prompts de imagem, Título, Descrição, Hashtags, CTA.
Implement the Admin panel to view users, stats, and revenue.
Mock the Google Auth flow and Upgrade to Premium flow.
Do NOT use default Inter font for headings. Apply Unbounded for headings and Manrope for body text via index.css.
Add 'data-testid' attributes extensively to all interactive elements for testing.
